locations.name: Majestic Theaters Tempe
locations.description: Majestic Theaters' original Tempe location (marketed as "Majestic Tempe 7"), a locally-owned AZ dine-in chain with a full bar and food ordered via QR code and delivered to your seat by a server. Seating is mixed here — not every seat reclines, so reviewers recommend checking the seat map when booking, and a few note some seats are showing wear. Reviews are generally positive on food and staff friendliness, with one detailed complaint about a billing discrepancy (an unexplained extra charge on top of a gift card balance) that wasn't resolved to the guest's satisfaction.

locations.name: Majestic Theaters Chandler
locations.description: Majestic Theaters' Chandler location ("Majestic Chandler 9"), known for $5 Tuesday tickets, a full bar with beers on tap and a happy hour, and chairside food/drink service ordered via QR code. Reviewers consistently praise the popcorn (served with clarified butter) and friendly staff. Recurring notes include occasionally slow, understaffed service and a building reviewers describe as starting to show its age, though the overall movie-going experience is rated positively.

locations.name: Majestic Theaters Gilbert
locations.description: Majestic Theaters' Gilbert location ("Majestic Gilbert 8"), a locally-owned alternative to the larger chains that reviewers frequently compare favorably to Harkins. Comfortable seating (some reviewers wish it reclined further back), a full bar, and food — including a well-reviewed clarified-butter popcorn and chicken tenders — brought to your seat by staff so you don't have to leave during the movie. One reviewer had a billing error with a bottomless-popcorn order, which Majestic corrected and refunded; ordering popcorn refills requires re-ordering through the app rather than just asking a server, which a couple of reviewers found more distracting than helpful.
